proposal.summary: Eclipse Mosquitto 1.3.2 through 2.x before 2.0.16 contains a memory leak in the broker that can be triggered remotely when a client sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs and fails to respond to PUBREC, due to mishandling of EAGAIN from the libc send function.

AC.quote: when a client sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs, and fails to respond to PUBREC commands

proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce against the stated versions by sending many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs and not responding to PUBREC to observe memory growth; if confirmed, identify and patch the code path that mishandles EAGAIN from send(2). Coordinate disclosure and recommend updating to 2.0.16 or later once fixed.
